latest_release.body:
We're moving beyond `0.0.x` and into `0.1.0`!

This release brings major improvements across scraping, crawling, AI-powered data extraction, document processing, and MCP. We've also rebuilt parts of the experience to make Maxun more capable, reliable, and useful as an open-source web data platform.

Here's what's new.

## ⚡ Faster scraping, better results

Scraping is now **4× faster**, dropping from 2.5 seconds to 0.63 seconds in our local benchmark covering text, links, Markdown, HTML, and screenshots.

We've also improved the quality of extracted content across 91 real-world pages:

- **26% higher precision** - less irrelevant content in the output.
- **12% higher F1 score** - a better balance between precision and completeness.
- **20% smaller output** - less data to process downstream.
- **99% recall maintained** - virtually all expected content is still captured, with no page losing recall in our benchmark.

The result: faster scraping, cleaner output, and less unnecessary data.

Content extraction is more precise, output is smaller, and no page lost recall in the benchmark.

## 🤖 A new AI Mode

AI Mode has been rebuilt to make natural-language data extraction more useful and reliable.

Previously, AI Mode relied on captured lists (based on recorder mode) from the page. It now builds an extraction robot based on your prompt and the data available on the specified page.

Describe the data you want and Maxun builds a reusable robot to extract it.

Once created, the robot can be run repeatedly without making LLM calls on every run, keeping subsequent extractions fast and cost-efficient.

**Want more autonomy?** Maxun Cloud also offers Agent, which can discover relevant pages and configure websites to find the data you need. We'll continue improving both AI-powered workflows in upcoming releases.

Learn more here: https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/llm-extraction, https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/agent

## 🕷️ Crawling is faster and cleaner

Crawling is now **77% faster**, with our benchmark dropping from 411 seconds to 96 seconds.

We've also reduced duplicate and irrelevant data, so crawls return cleaner, more useful results:

- **100% fewer duplicate links** in the output, down from 28% to zero.
- **50% smaller HTML output per page**, from 280 KB to 139 KB.
- **16% higher Markdown precision**, reducing irrelevant content in extracted pages.
- **No duplicate articles** in the benchmark, down from 23.

The result: faster crawls, less redundant data, and cleaner output for downstream processing.

## 📄 Better document extraction


Document Robots are now better at extracting structured data from large and complex files, including PDFs, spreadsheets, CSVs, and DOCX documents.

- **More complete results:** Preserve document metadata alongside line items and other records.
- **Better large-file handling:** Recover from truncated model responses and process document chunks in parallel.
- **Improved table parsing:** Preserve table structure, headers, and row order across file formats.
- **More accurate data:** Better handling of dates, international number formats, and duplicate records.

In tests with simulated model responses and realistic output limits:

- **Invoices:** Recovered all 4 header fields and all 60 line items.
- **Bank statements:** Extracted all 300 transactions, up from 25.
- **CSV files:** Extracted all 1,500 orders, up from 5 rows.

Document Robots are now substantially more reliable when processing large files and datasets.

## 🔌 A new MCP server

The previous MCP implementation has been replaced with a new, more capable server that exposes Maxun's core functionality directly to AI assistants and MCP clients.

New one-shot tools include:

- `maxun_scrape` - Scrape a page as Markdown, HTML, text, links, a summary, or screenshots, with optional Smart Queries.
- `maxun_crawl`- Crawl a website with configurable scope, depth, and include/exclude p

## What Maxun Does - **[Extract](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/extract)** – Extract structured data from any website by emulating real user behavior. * **[Recorder Mode](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/robot-actions)** – Record browser actions and turn them into reusable extraction robots. * **[AI Mode](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/llm-extraction)** – Describe what you need in natural language and extract it with AI. - [Setup with Docker Compose](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/docker) 2. [Setup without Docker](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/local) 3. [Environment Variables](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/environment_variables) 4. [SDK](https://github.com/getmaxun/node-sdk) ### Upgrading & Self Hosting 1. [Self Host Maxun With Docker](https://docs.maxun.dev/self-host) 2. [Upgrade Maxun With Docker Compose Setup](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-docker-compose) 3. [Upgrade Maxun Without Docker Compose Setup](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-local-setup) ## License
